name: SBI General Arogya Premier Policy

room_rent.note: The wording lists room rent as covered but states no limit; the limit and any co-payment are set in the policy schedule, which is not part of this document.

waiting_initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.

waiting_ped.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy

specific_waits.label: Gall bladder stones

specific_waits.label: Chronic Renal failure

specific_waits.label: Hypertension and Heart Disease

sublimits.quote: The following disorders / conditions shall be covered only up to Rs. 1,00,000/-. This sub-limit shall apply for all the following disorders / conditions on cumulative basis.
sublimits.label: Mental Illness specific disorders

sublimits.quote: Genetic Disorders or Diseases are covered up to the Limit Rs. 1,00,000
sublimits.label: Genetic Disorders or Diseases

sublimits.quote: Internal Congenital Diseases are Covered upto the Limit Rs. 10% of Sum Insured.
sublimits.label: Internal Congenital Diseases

sublimits.quote: The following procedures will be covered (wherever medically indicated) either as in patient or as part of day care treatment in a hospital up to 50% of -of Sum Insured, specified in the policy schedule, during the policy period
sublimits.label: Specified Advanced Procedures

exclusions.quote: Treatment taken outside India.

War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, commotion, unrest, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation or nationalisation
Injury or disease directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by nuclear weapons/materials.
Circumcision unless necessary for treatment of a disease, illness or injury not excluded hereunder, or, as may be necessitated due to an accident
exclusions.text: Circumcision unless required for disease or accident

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.

Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment to remove a direct and immediate health risk to the insured.
The cost of spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, artificial limbs, dentures, artificial teeth and all other external appliances , prosthesis and/or devices.

Expenses incurred on items for personal comfort like television, telephone, etc. Incurred during hospitalization and which have been specifically charged for in the hospitalisation bills issued by the hospital/nursing home.

External medical equipment of any kind used at home as post hospitalisation care including cost of instrument used in the treatment of sleep apnoea syndrome (C.P.A.P), continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (C.A.P.D) and oxygen concentrator for bronchial asthmatic condition.
exclusions.text: External medical equipment used at home

exclusions.quote: Dental treatment or surgery of any kind unless required as a result of accidental bodily injury to teeth requiring hospitalization treatment.
exclusions.text: Dental treatment or surgery unless due to accidental bodily injury

exclusions.quote: Convalescence, general debility, “run-down” condition, rest cure, i/external congenital anomaly.
exclusions.text: Convalescence, general debility, rest cure, external congenital anomaly

exclusions.quote: Intentional self-injury and suicide (including but not limited to the use or misuse of any intoxicating drugs or alcohol)
Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
exclusions.text: Breach of law with criminal intent

exclusions.quote: Treatment for, Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof.
Venereal disease or any sexually transmitted disease or sickness. (excluding HIV / AIDS as mentioned under scope of cover)
exclusions.text: Venereal disease or sexually transmitted disease (excluding HIV/AIDS)

exclusions.quote: Outpatient department treatment

Expenses related to sterility and infertility this includes: i. Any type of sterilization ii. Assisted Reproduction services including artificial insemination and advanced reproductive technologies such as IVF, ZIFT, GIFT ICSI iii. Gestational Surrogacy iv. Reversal of sterilization
Vaccination or inoculation except as part of post-bite treatment for animal bite.
exclusions.text: Vaccination or inoculation except post animal bite

exclusions.quote: Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including but not limited to Vitamins, minerals and organic substances unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of hospitalization claim or day care procedure.
Surgery to correct deviated septum and hypertrophied turbinate unless necessitated by an accidental body injury.
exclusions.text: Surgery to correct deviated septum and hypertrophied turbinate unless accidental

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex
